limitations: Normal states at all 132 route/viewports were inspected using AX/DOM. Fresh visual screenshots were taken only at representative mobile states, not 132 screenshots.
Generic error boundaries, partial-service failures, projection delays, unauthenticated redirect, real uploads and successful saves/publish/delete were not induced.
Only citizen invoice empty-results and search-return flows were interacted with; sibling lists share the reviewed implementation.
No user data was created, updated, published, unpublished or deleted.
No screen reader or 200% zoom session was performed; keyboard and DOM accessibility evidence do not establish full compliance.
Native screenshots were displayed in the tool transcript; this artifact does not claim newly saved raster files.
